name: hbm_su_qcore_r19b_1022-r19b-COMMIT
purpose: R18b final route NEEDS_RTL/ECO (r18b TT -37.57 / FF -32.8, DRC 0; path_summary worst reg2reg class g_wv[*].u_wv/q -> g_b.g_h.g_r.q D, 17 levels: wv_c -> sector compare -> bank compare -> selq -> data AND-OR -> COL mux -> en). R19 opt-in WDEC=1: the writer (sector,bank) one-hot is decoded from rf_wa BEFORE the existing raw capture edge (as the r16 COLL row hit and the read predecode), each sector captures 32 (writer,bank) hit bits, hit = wv_c & captured bit (one AND). Same ports, k capture, k+1 commit, priority/COL override/conflict, reset (wv_c stays the reset capture). ROW_EN=2 kept. Geometry = r18b kit unchanged.
